heading: Definitions
lead: As used in sections 4914 to 4916 of this title, the term—

tree.text: “academic year” means a regular school year, consisting of two semesters;
“page” means a page of the House of Representatives, but such term does not include a full time, permanent employee of the House of Representatives with supervisory responsibility for pages; and
“congressional page” means a page of the House of Representatives or the Senate.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 88c–4 of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section. Section is based on section 4 of House Resolution No. 234, Ninety-eighth Congress, June 29, 1983, which was enacted into permanent law by Pub. L. 98–367.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective June 29, 1983, see note set out under section 4914 of this title.
